objectives: 培養學生利用簡化等效模型等分析工具，瞭解熟悉各種基本電子元件的工作模式(包含二極體、電晶體、場效應晶體、運算放大器等)，以及相關的基礎應用 (如放大電路、振盪器、濾波器等)。
content:
(1). Basic circuits theory
(2). Solid-state diodes and diode circuits
(3). Bipolar junction transistors
(4). Basic BJT amplifiers
(5). Field effect transistors
(6). Operational amplifiers
(7). Digital logic circuits
(8). Frequency response (optional)
(9). Oscillators (optional)
(10). Feedback amplifiers (optional)“
books:
教科書：
(1) Muhammad H. Rashid, "Microelectronic Circuits Analysis and Design", 3/e

References:
(1) Sedra & Smith, "Microelectronic Circuits," 8th Ed.
(2) Behzad Razavi, "Microelectronics" 2nd Ed.

distribution_conditions.rule: 系所:限光電科學與工程學系碩士在職專班。
